sections.description: Independent SEO management for FarmNeed with WooCommerce schema, redirects, 404 monitoring, Search Console tools, IndexNow activity, internal-link analysis, SEO health reports, social preview, and merchant policy schema.
sections.changelog: 1.3.1: Fixes Product seller Organization structured data so the business logo is included. 1.3.0: Consolidates stable FarmNeed SEO functionality into the standalone plugin and adds a self-hosted update channel.
